release_name: Live TV v3.9.1 — Continuous SPOTV 2 HD Playback & Software CENC Decryptor
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🏍️ Continuous SPOTV 2 HD Playback: Integrated WebCrypto in-memory CENC decryptor, permanently resolving macOS WebKit 30-second black screen / decode error
⚡ Pure 1080p Stream Stability: Intercepts and decrypts DASH fMP4 segments cleanly without EME, allowing uninterrupted 1080p 60fps streaming
🛡️ Intelligent Health Watchdog: Removed false-positive freeze triggers and prevents auto-switching to Red Bull TV when SPOTV 2 is streaming smoothly
🔊 Fixed Audio Volume Clamping: Resolved WebKit volume > 100% IndexSizeError crash
✨ Retains all v3.9 features: Multi-View Studio, Phone Remote with auto-reconnect, Drag-to-resize PiP, and full catalog of 2,989 channels
